summary: Spot The Difference backend tested end-to-end via 23 pytest cases — ALL 23 PASS (100%). Verified: catalog (6 themes + 4 difficulties w/ correct diffs/points/hints/ribbon shape), per-day stable seed for puzzle_id+differences, exact diff counts per difficulty (easy=3, moderate=5, hard=7, nightmare=10) with x/y/radius tap-hit fields, /daily endpoint deterministic + dated, progress upsert + GET round-trip, points rules (Easy/Moderate = 0 incl. when beat_the_clock=true; Hard = 15; Nightmare = 25; Hard+BTC under 240s = 23; Hard+BTC over 240s = 15), idempotent re-saves (no double award), 'hard'/'nightmare' achievements granted and an 'achievement' Flutter pushed to friends (verified maggie received it after frankie completed a Hard), daily_challenge achievement on first daily-of-day + streak ≥ 1, per-difficulty personal-bests improving on better time, and /games/dailies aggregator returning jigsaw+trivia+wordsearch+memory+sudoku without spot (intentional per spec).
action_items: Optional follow-up (not a bug): consider adding 'spot' to /api/games/dailies aggregator so the home screen surfaces today's Spot The Difference daily puzzle alongside the other daily games. Currently the aggregator returns jigsaw/trivia/wordsearch/memory/sudoku only.
critical_code_review_comments: spot_save_progress idempotency relies on a 'completed_logged' flag — correct and verified: a re-POST after completion does NOT re-award points or re-grant 'hard'/'nightmare' achievements.
Beat-the-Clock logic correctly gates bonus on points_awarded > 0, so Easy/Moderate runs with beat_the_clock=true correctly yield 0 points (intentional per spec).
spot_difference.py is clean (~350 lines), pure functions, no DB coupling — good factoring.
Friend Flutter broadcast uses notifications.type field (n_type='achievement') — verified delivered to mutual friend on Hard/Nightmare completion.
seed_data_creation: Set frankie+maggie to be mutual friends and cleared maggie.blocked (was previously blocking frankie). Per the agent-to-agent context, blocked arrays were 'reset' as instructed. The friendship was added for the Flutter broadcast test — this is intentional setup the request asked for. NOT reverted (per the request which said 'they must be friends').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file lives at /app/backend/tests/test_spot_difference.py. It self-cleans frankie's spot_progress + spot game_completions + hard/nightmare/daily_challenge achievements both pre- and post-run, so it's safe to re-run anytime. It also touches joycey/art/dot/maggie for isolated sub-tests and cleans their spot data too. The frankie<->maggie friendship and maggie's unblocked state were intentionally left in place (matches the request). XML report: /app/test_reports/pytest/spot_difference_results.xml.
rca_of_issue: One initial test failure ('Friend (maggie) did not receive achievement Flutter notification') was a test-side bug: I queried db.notifications with field 'kind' but the production push_notification() writes the field as 'type'. Fixed in the test and re-ran — Flutter delivery to friends on Hard completion is working correctly in the backend.
